text:
alex: Kicking off sequential region cutover for release v2.3.1. Plan = US -> EU -> APAC. Canary 5% for 15m per region, then 25% for 30m, then 100% if green. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. @ops-oncall please stand by. Pin fallback versions in each region just in case.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout-id=rl-2026-11-04-0912, initiated by alex. Command: `rwdctl rollout start --release v2.3.1 --mode sequential --regions us,eu,ap`

sanjay: Running quick capacity sweep US-east:
```
region: us-east-1
gpu_pools: 3
active_nodes: 18
available_gpus: 12
current_util: 58%
queue_depth: normal
```

lucy: US canary (5%) smoke: p50=38ms p95=112ms p99=220ms errors=0.02% - heatmap looks fine. No mem spikes on models.

rachel: Starting EU canary now. I'll pin EU fallback to rwd/infer-lite:v2.3.0 for quick rollback: `rwdctl model pin --region eu-west-1 --model rwd/infer-lite:v2.3.0`

ops-oncall: Quick note - APAC (ap-southeast-1) current spare capacity low: available_gpus=2. If we proceed without scale-up we risk queuing/timeout at 25% traffic.

alex: OK hold APAC for now. Proceed US->EU, pause before APAC. Sanjay can you request burst capacity in APAC (2 nodes) or recommend reroute to dedicated pool?

sanjay: Triggered scale-up request to cloud: `scale-request --region ap-southeast-1 --add-nodes 2` job=scale-7892. Est start ~4m, bootstrap ~8m. Also flagged autoscaler policy to allow burst.

deploy-bot: EU canary success. rollout-id=rl-2026-11-04-0912 region=eu-west-1 status=canary_pass -> advancing to 25%

lucy: EU 25% metrics at +20m: p50=41ms p95=130ms errors=0.04% - small increase but within regression guardrails. No model quality alerts.

ops-oncall: APAC scale job in progress; cloud reports nodes provisioning. ETA 10m to be fully ready. Recommend we schedule APAC cutover +30m from now to absorb provisioning.

alex: Good. We're moving APAC to T+30. Reminder of rollback triggers: auto-rollback if 5xx >0.5% for 10m OR p95 >400ms sustained for 5m. Also manual pin fallback if weird model drift.

sanjay: APAC nodes ready (scale-7892 done). Verified available_gpus now 8. Quick check below:
```
ap-southeast-1
gpu_pools: 2
active_nodes: 6
available_gpus: 8
current_util: 42%
```

deploy-bot: Starting APAC canary 5% -> region=ap-southeast-1 rollout-step=canary

lucy: APAC canary smoke: p50=45ms p95=210ms errors=0.1% - noticing slight tail increase; monitoring.

ops-oncall: Not seeing queueing. Latency tail ok but keep an eye on model cache warmups. If p95 climbs above 300ms for 5m, we should trigger rollback.

alex: Hold on extra 10m for warmup. If stable, we go to 25% then full. Reminder: EU pinned for 1h as fallback. Release notes published: https://internal.redwood.com/releases/v2.3.1 - please add any post-deploy observations there.

rachel: EU pin will be unpinned automatically after 1h unless we extend. I set a canary annotation: `canary-note: hold-fallback=europe-pin`

sanjay: All regions now at 25% and holding. Current aggregate metrics: errors=0.03% p95=135ms overall. No rollbacks.

lucy: Rolling monitoring checklist: traces, token-cost delta, stray 5xx spikes. So far clean.

alex: Proceed to full rollout in US/EU. APAC to 100% if next 20m stable. Great job everyone. If we see >0.5% 5xx or p95 >400ms we rollback automatically and notify #incidents.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete for us-east-1 and eu-west-1 -> status=successful. APAC pending final hold window -> next check scheduled at 1845123580.

ops-oncall: APAC held for warmup then promoted to 100% at T+38m. No issues observed. Closing the cutover.

alex: Closing notes: pin window for EU 1h, rollback policy reiterated, release notes linked. Thanks team :tada:
